next.reason: §2023:14.9.37.4 GR3 restates 1985 GR8: the search index is VARYING index-name-1 when it is in identifier-1's INDEXED BY phrase, else the first (or only) index-name; another table's index-name-1: 'The index referenced by index-name-1 is incremented by one occurrence number at the same time as the search index is incremented' (1985's 'same amount' as one occurrence); an index data item identifier-2 incremented by the same amount, an integer one by one (1985 SR2 limits identifier-2 to those two). §2023:14.9.37.4 GR1 states that the VARYING item is the additional item varied. Same for every 1985 program.
